choose.when: SELECT uid , menu_code , link_url , title , color , top_margin FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND level = 1 AND display_in_menu = '1' ORDER BY display_ordinal ASC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT uid , menu_code , link_url , title , color , top_margin , display_ordinal FROM ( SELECT AM.uid , AM.menu_code , AM.link_url , AM.title , AM.color , AM.top_margin , AM.display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU AM JOIN ADMIN_MENU_PERMISSION AMP ON ( (AM.auth_code <> '' AND AM.auth_code = AMP.menu_code) OR (AM.menu_code = AMP.menu_code) ) WHERE AM.level = 1 AND AM.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND AM.display_in_menu = '1' AND AMP.worker_id = #{workerId} AND AMP.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}'
UNION
SELECT uid , menu_code , link_url , title , color , top_margin , display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE level = 1 AND on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND display_in_menu = '1' AND default_permission = '1' ) T ORDER BY display_ordinal ASC

choose.when: SELECT uid , menu_code , parent_code , link_url , title , color FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND level = 2 AND display_in_menu = '1' ORDER BY display_ordinal ASC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT uid , menu_code , parent_code , link_url , title , color , display_ordinal FROM ( SELECT AM.uid , AM.menu_code , AM.parent_code , AM.link_url , AM.title , AM.color , AM.display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU AM JOIN ADMIN_MENU_PERMISSION AMP ON ( (AM.auth_code <> '' AND AM.auth_code = AMP.menu_code) OR (AM.menu_code = AMP.menu_code) ) WHERE AM.level = 2 AND AM.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND AM.display_in_menu = '1' AND AMP.worker_id = #{workerId} AND AMP.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}'
UNION
SELECT uid , menu_code , parent_code , link_url , title , color , display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE level = 2 AND on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND display_in_menu = '1' AND default_permission = '1' ) T ORDER BY display_ordinal ASC

choose.when: SELECT AM.uid , AM.menu_code , AM.link_url , AM.title , AM.color , ((SELECT display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE menu_code = AM.parent_code AND level = 1) * 1000 + AM.display_ordinal) AS bookmark_display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU_BOOKMARK AMB JOIN ADMIN_MENU AM ON AM.menu_code = AMB.menu_code WHERE AM.level = 2 AND AM.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND (AM.display_in_menu = '1' OR AM.tab_code <> '') AND AMB.worker_id = #{workerId} AND AMB.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ORDER BY bookmark_display_ordinal ASC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT uid , menu_code , link_url , title , color FROM ( SELECT AM.uid , AM.menu_code , AM.link_url , AM.title , AM.color , ((SELECT display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE menu_code = AM.parent_code AND level = 1) * 1000 + AM.display_ordinal) AS bookmark_display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU_BOOKMARK AMB JOIN ADMIN_MENU AM ON AM.menu_code = AMB.menu_code LEFT JOIN ADMIN_MENU_PERMISSION AMP ON ( (AM.auth_code <> '' AND AM.auth_code = AMP.menu_code) OR (AM.menu_code = AMP.menu_code) ) WHERE AM.level = 2 AND AM.on_service = '1' AND (AM.display_in_menu = '1' OR AM.tab_code <> '') AND AMB.worker_id = #{workerId} AND AMB.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND ( AM.tab_code <> '' OR ( AM.display_in_menu = '1' AND AMP.worker_id = #{workerId} AND AMP.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ) )
UNION
SELECT AM.uid , AM.menu_code , AM.link_url , AM.title , AM.color , ((SELECT display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE menu_code = AM.parent_code AND level = 1) * 1000 + AM.display_ordinal) AS bookmark_display_ordinal FROM ADMIN_MENU_BOOKMARK AMB JOIN ADMIN_MENU AM ON AM.menu_code = AMB.menu_code WHERE AM.level = 2 AND AM.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND (AM.display_in_menu = '1' OR AM.tab_code <> '') AND AM.default_permission = '1' AND AMB.worker_id = #{workerId} AND AMB.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ) T ORDER BY bookmark_display_ordinal ASC

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(p.title, c.title) AS main_title , c.title AS sub_title , c.menu_code , c.parent_code FROM admin_menu c LEFT JOIN admin_menu p ON c.parent_code = p.menu_code AND p.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' WHERE c.link_url = #{linkUrl} AND c.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' LIMIT 1
